creativeThesis: A laboratory changes orientation to change how it responds to a moving ocean.
viewerExperience: See an impossible-looking upright lab, understand the moving-reference problem, watch the engineered rotation, discover the long submerged shape, and remember that stability improves measurement without eliminating motion.
emotionalTarget: Immediate wonder becoming clear engineering understanding, with an honest scientific limit.
visualThesis: One hull and one waterline carry the explanation; reveal depth and meaningful motion instead of replacing each idea with a text panel.

decisions.treatment: Original spatial ocean illustration: one recognizable historical FLIP hull develops from vertical mystery through instrument problem, horizontal tow, ballast rotation, submerged cutaway, wave interaction and return. No selected archive or generated bitmap.
decisions.rationale: Underwater geometry is the explanatory payoff and cannot be observed in exterior footage alone. Connected spatial identity prevents a sequence of unrelated diagrams.
alternativesConsidered: Archival-led exterior rotation montage followed by separate engineering cards.
Laboratory instrument first: moving reference and acoustic bearing puzzle before revealing FLIP.
Minimal dark schematic board with one small rotating FLIP icon and labels.

decisions.treatment: A clean daylight horizon and pale upper sky over deep ocean blue; warm neutral metal hull with restrained orange ballast/air cues. Preserve historical long spar, tapered upper section and recognizable above-water lab/booms. Shift camera scale and cutaway mode with the explanation.
decisions.rationale: Daylight makes orientation and waterline legible instantly; dark water gives depth without inheriting a documentary board. Functional colors separate water, hull and process rather than decorate.

decisions.treatment: Current Kokoro af_heart, connected English sentences at natural measured speed; invite the opening question, give a brief comprehension hold at underwater reveal, keep qualification audible. FLIP as one syllable /flɪp/.
decisions.rationale: Established narrator and plain language; actual generated audio and listening review still required. No audition merely for engineering domain.

decisions.treatment: Designed burned-in speech phrases using established licensed Manrope; sentence meaning and exact approved internal wording preserved. Calm lower speech field independent of ocean/waves; size and segmentation chosen from actual narration and phone-scale decoding later.
decisions.rationale: Readability is brand continuity; do not import48px or existing cue durations as automatic authority. Captions support the diagram rather than becoming diagram labels.

decisions.treatment: Propose subtle original ocean ambience with a short illustrative water/air cue at ballast and return, ducked beneath speech. No music bed selected; use a brief reduction of ambience for the geometry insight.
decisions.rationale: Water/air changes explain the process and connect the spatial scene. Compare voice-only during actual production; retain only cues that help, never disaster splash, fabricated recorded ship sound or decoration.

decisions.treatment: 149-word explanation; runtime follows actual complete sentence narration and necessary visual grasp time. Required schema50–95s is a provisional planning envelope, not a hard limit, quota or approval. Ballast rotation is time-compressed and identified as such.
decisions.rationale: Mystery, why, how, geometry, limitation and payoff each earn a beat. No designer timeline or monetization target may pad or rush the explanation.

decisions.treatment: First frame already shows vertical FLIP: visible laboratory above a clear waterline and long hull below in an explicitly illustrated cutaway. A small schematic surface reference makes unusual orientation unmistakable; first sentence asks why scientists deliberately tipped it upright.
decisions.rationale: Prefer instantly understandable end state over a slow transit introduction. Rotation-first alternative has movement but needs recognition of the unflipped object; test legibility in the future render, not by declaring this proposal successful.

decisions.treatment: Plan a9:16 master with essential lab/waterline/hull and speech separated; future production chooses exact geometry and binds current profiles. Inspect actual decoded phone-scale opening, cutaway and captions later; native device/crop uncertainty persists.
decisions.rationale: Proposed composition is not proof of platform safety or native presentation. No platform variants, cover, package, scheduling or publication work in this stage.

convergenceReview.conclusion: Reuse narration/caption engineering intentionally; change spatial treatment for actual geometry and causal motion. Direction readiness does not certify finished creative quality.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Exact four latest available owner-approved masters by immutable decision-entry order, excluding current asset; no analytics/category selection.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: An extraordinary physical object in ocean space becomes intelligible through its transformation and revealed depth.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: Rejected small rotating icon in inherited evidence board; retained caption/voice continuity independently of medium, palette and sound.

ownerReview.rationale: Routine internal direction within approved premise and established brand/capabilities. No separate normal script/visual owner gate under V3. User-scoped hold on master production remains; this record does not override it.

risks: No verified original1963/1997 body inspection; selected wording supported by inspected operator technical history and later primary field report.
Ballast compartments/procedure are schematic; no arbitrary hinge, full-scale plunge or sinking accident.
Deep-water wave motion decreases continuously with depth; no hard still-water boundary or tsunami/current immunity.
Residual drift/tilt must appear and be spoken; no fake measurement plot or numerical response ratio.
Research-only brochure image and academic figures cannot become production assets without rights review.
Opening legibility, useful audio, actual pronunciation, runtime, native presentation and complete-render creative quality remain untested.

provenance.notes: Actual primary source text, operator diagram and rendered prior contact sheets/detail images inspected; internally verified exact script and claim package. No newly rendered creative artifact, actual audio listening or platform action.
